title: APRV with a strong drive: high effort and pendelluft at Phigh
summary: ARDS on APRV 30/0 with a patient pulling hard at Phigh. The airway pressure barely moves, so the screen looks calm; the balloon shows a large ΔPes and the truth layer a high dynamic transpulmonary pressure with gas swinging between regions. The fix treats the drive.
objectives: Read the effort on the balloon (ΔPes) and on the truth layer (ΔPL,dyn, pendelluft) while Paw sits flat at Phigh.
Fix by treating the drive: analgesia and sedation to Pmax 8 at 16 a minute.

fix.note: Treat the drive (analgesia, sedation): Pmax 8, rate 16.
